what: A test that slices the source by a diagnostic's range has to slice the text after the fixture's `//- minicore:` line: I put that line inside the string I sliced and got `"pub fn "` where the call was. And an intrinsic of a made-up name (`raw`) makes `mir_body` fail (`UnknownIntrinsic`), so a check that reads MIR answers nothing for the whole body.
cost: two rounds of the shared build (about 25 minutes with the queue)
cause: the fixture's header is not part of the file; lowering looks an intrinsic up by name
workaround: copy `tests/mir/const_check.rs`'s `check` helper's shape; use a real intrinsic's name (`variant_count`)
fix: a shared `refused_text(src, name)` helper in tests/mir/main.rs that every span-slicing test uses
